messages:
Maya: Quick q — where should we surface the 'actor_justification' field in the console & exports? Compliance asked for 'who changed what' + reason, and wants easy evidence retrieval.
Devon: My take: show inline in the change row (compact) with a small "reason" pill (hover reveals full text), and put the full justification in the change details drawer.
Jana: +1. For exports, include a top-level field 'actor_justification' in NDJSON lines. Export guidance: redact PII at rest but keep original for admin-only bundles. Example NDJSON line:
```json
{"change_id":"chg_01F...","actor":"deborah","actor_role":"admin","actor_justification":"corrected routing table to include prod cluster","ts":"2024-06-12T18:34:22Z"}
```
Sam R: Telemetry: emit an event when someone views justification in the console (reason_viewed) and when any export bundle is generated (export_request). Also track user/tenant and export redaction level.
Maya: Good — product also wants justification searchable via the console quick filter.
Devon: Searchable indexing concern: full-text indexing every justification can blow up index size. Suggest we index a 256-char prefix + trigram index; store full text in our blob store and serve via the details pane.
Jana: If we store full text off-index, the UI should surface a 200-char preview and a link to request full view (permission check). Exports initiated by allowed roles should include the full justification.
Sam R: Permission model proposal: roles with 'audit:export' or 'audit:view_full' get unredacted justification. Others get masked or summary. We should also allow a flag on the export API: redaction=none|partial|pii-only.
ops-bot: Security note — export bundles to S3 must use SSE-KMS, have least-priv on the presigned URL, and TTL auto-delete. Log export job actor and IP.
Maya: UX question: make justification required for certain high-risk ops (routing policy deletes, quota overrides, privileged rollouts)? Product leans yes.
Devon: For those ops require modal with a short justification field (max 1k chars). If user skips, gate with escalation (auto-request approver or require 2nd sign-off).
Jana: Implementation notes: API change: add optional string 'justification' on /changes POST. DB: persist as Change.justification (text) + Justification.redaction_level enum. Return justification in /changes/:id only if caller has permission.
Sam R: Export schema change: NDJSON lines get 'actor_justification' and 'justification_redaction' fields. Also include a small provenance blob for canary/rollout links (rollout_id if any).
Maya: Ops items: 1) API + DB field (Sam/Devon) 2) Console pill + detail + preview + search (Devon/Jana) 3) Telemetry + export audit logs + access events (Sam) 4) Enforcement modal + approver flow (Product/PM) 5) Docs + compliance signoff (Maya).
Devon: I'll open a draft PR with a migration stub and API param.
Sam R: I'll draft the export NDJSON spec and redaction semantics.
Maya: Thanks — I'll capture this in a short RFC and loop in legal/compliance. :thumbsup:
